import json, hashlib, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'scripts/audit_backups.sh'
BASE = len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == 'base'
def put(p, text):
    p = root / p
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
def get(p):
    return (root / p).read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
def tree(p):
    base = root / p
    return {str(f.relative_to(base)): f.read_bytes().decode('utf-8') for f in base.rglob('*') if f.is_file()}
def run(*args, code=0):
    run.calls = getattr(run, 'calls', 0) + 1
    relative = run.calls % 2 == 0
    actual = [str(value) if relative or not (i in (0, 1, 2)) else str(root / str(value)) for i, value in enumerate(args)]
    r = subprocess.run(['bash', str(SCRIPT), *actual], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
    assert r.returncode == code, (args, r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr)
    return r
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ops-check-') as temporary:
    root = Path(temporary) / 'work area'
    root.mkdir()
    for p, text in INPUTS.items():
        put(p, text)
    import csv,io
    def verify(store,catalog):
        before=tree(store);manifest_before=get(catalog)
        expected={r['path']:int(r['bytes']) for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(manifest_before),delimiter='\t')}
        want='path\tissue\n'
        for p in sorted(set(before)|set(expected)):
            issue='extra' if p not in expected else 'missing' if p not in before else 'size' if len(before[p].encode('utf-8'))!=expected[p] else ''
            if issue:want+=p+'\t'+issue+'\n'
        run(store,catalog,'reports area/catalog.tsv')
        assert get('reports area/catalog.tsv') == want
        assert tree(store) == before and get(catalog) == manifest_before
    verify('backup store','config/backup-catalog.tsv')
    put('small store/中文.txt','中\n');put('small store/empty.txt','')
    put('small catalog.tsv','path\tbytes\n中文.txt\t4\nempty.txt\t0\n')
    verify('small store','small catalog.tsv')
    assert get('reports area/catalog.tsv') == 'path\tissue\n'
    put('small store/中文.txt','中文\n');verify('small store','small catalog.tsv')
    assert get('reports area/catalog.tsv') == 'path\tissue\n中文.txt\tsize\n'
    put('all suffix store/.hidden','hidden\n');put('all suffix store/data.sql','select 1;\n')
    put('all suffix catalog.tsv','path\tbytes\nmissing\t0\n')
    verify('all suffix store','all suffix catalog.tsv')
    assert get('reports area/catalog.tsv') == 'path\tissue\n.hidden\textra\ndata.sql\textra\nmissing\tmissing\n'
    (root/'no backups').mkdir();put('no catalog.tsv','path\tbytes\n')
    verify('no backups','no catalog.tsv');assert get('reports area/catalog.tsv') == 'path\tissue\n'
